sections.label: Supply Bill appropriations approval
sections.summary: The Supply Bill seeks legislative approval for appropriations from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund for the Financial Year 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The purpose of the Supply Bill before Members is, therefore, to give legislative approval for the appropriations from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund to meet the expenditure in the Financial Year, 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Heads of Expenditure and the sums that may be incurred in respect of each Head are shown in the Schedule to the Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: These have been approved by the House in the Main and Development Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year, 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018, as contained in Paper Cmd No 8 of 2017.
